BookAppointmentData.description:
PUBLIC booking payload — the only surface the Astro landing page posts to
(`POST /api/appointments`). Unlike the admin {@see AppointmentData}, this DTO
requires `scheduled_at`: a first-time booking always requests a specific
date/time, validated by {@see AppointmentScheduler}
(not in the past, inside an open availability window, not already taken).
BookAppointmentData.title: BookAppointmentData

CampaignAdFormat.description: Meta Ads placement/format. `LeadForm` targets Meta's native Instant Forms — the single highest-intent lead-gen unit on Meta — and is the format the generation agent leans on when `business_goal` is Leads.
CampaignAdFormat.title: CampaignAdFormat

CampaignBusinessGoal.description: Campaigns is a paid Meta Ads module — every goal here is acquisition or retention-oriented, unlike SocialMedia's organic set (which also allows 'viral'/'community'). Own Domain enum copy — modules never cross-import.
CampaignBusinessGoal.title: CampaignBusinessGoal

CampaignFunnelStage.description: TOFU/MOFU/BOFU/LOYALTY classification the topic-ideation agent assigns to every candidate Meta Ads angle. Drives which CTA and Meta objective rules the generation agent applies — Loyalty is the 4th stage (retention/ retargeting) real Meta Ads accounts budget separately from acquisition, per 2026 full-funnel playbooks (60-70% TOFU / 20-30% MOFU / 5-10% BOFU / 5-10% Loyalty budget split).
CampaignFunnelStage.title: CampaignFunnelStage

CampaignLanguage.description: Output language the user picks for AI generation — never inferred, always explicit (the same niche can be worked in either market).
CampaignLanguage.title: CampaignLanguage

CampaignPlatform.description: Meta Ads surface the campaign targets. 'Both' generates adapted copy for Facebook AND Instagram in one attempt (see PlatformCampaignContentData) — a single angle rarely needs a 3rd Meta surface, unlike SocialMedia's 5-network spread, so this stays a flat enum rather than a multi-select.
CampaignPlatform.title: CampaignPlatform

ContactSupportData.description:
Create/update payload for a contact-support submission. Store and Update share
100% of the fields and rules, so a single fused DTO is used (DTO Fusion Rule).
The `readed` flag is intentionally NOT part of this DTO — it is toggled through
the dedicated mark-as-read action, never mass-assigned from a form.

`#[MapInputName]` snake-cases the request payload (`first_name`, `sms_consent`)
onto the camelCase properties.
ContactSupportData.title: ContactSupportData

ContentLanguage.description: Output language the user picks for AI generation — never inferred, always explicit (the same topic/niche can be worked in either market).
ContentLanguage.title: ContentLanguage

ExceptionSource.description: Provenance of a date exception. A `Manual` row is a user-created override and is never touched by the holiday sync; a `Holiday` row is system-materialised from the country provider and is purged/rebuilt on a country change or the yearly sync. This is the single source of truth for the `source` column.
ExceptionSource.title: ExceptionSource

FunnelStage.description: TOFU/MOFU/BOFU classification the topic-ideation agent assigns to every candidate topic. Drives which CTA rules the content-generation agent applies — it is not cosmetic: TOFU never gets a hard-sell CTA, BOFU never gets a soft "follow for more".
FunnelStage.title: FunnelStage

GenerateCampaignData.description:
Input for Step 2 (quality-loop campaign generation). One instance is
reused across every iteration of
{@see GenerateCampaignJob}; only
the previous-scores/weaknesses feedback (passed separately to the port)
changes between iterations.
GenerateCampaignData.title: GenerateCampaignData

GenerateContentVariantData.description:
Shared input for the social-copy and reel-package generators — both need
only the chosen topic/angle/trend (from {@see PostTopicIdeaData} or a
freehand topic) plus the provider, same as {@see GeneratePostContentData}
minus the cover-image flag.
GenerateContentVariantData.title: GenerateContentVariantData

GeneratePostContentData.description:
Input for full draft generation: either a title picked from
{@see PostTopicIdeaData} or a freehand topic the user typed directly.
GeneratePostContentData.title: GeneratePostContentData

GenerateSocialMediaContentData.description:
Input for Step 2 (quality-loop content generation). One instance is reused
across every iteration of {@see \Modules\SocialMedia\Infrastructure\Queue\GenerateSocialMediaContentJob};
only the previous-scores/weaknesses feedback (passed separately to the
port) changes between iterations.
GenerateSocialMediaContentData.title: GenerateSocialMediaContentData

MeetingStatus.description: Lifecycle of a booked meeting. Null (no case) means "requested, not yet  * confirmed" — the three states below are only reached through the dedicated Confirm / Reschedule / Cancel command handlers, never a generic update.
MeetingStatus.title: MeetingStatus

StatusLead.description: Sales pipeline stage for a captured lead. `New` is the default on capture; {@see AddFollowUpCallHandler} auto -advances a `New` lead to `Called` on the first logged call attempt.
StatusLead.title: StatusLead

SuggestCampaignTopicsData.description:
Input for Step 1 (10 Meta Ads lead-gen angle candidates). `niche` is an
optional steer — when blank the agent leans entirely on the company
profile + Tavily trend research, mirroring
{@see SuggestSocialMediaTopicsData}.
SuggestCampaignTopicsData.title: SuggestCampaignTopicsData

SuggestPostTopicsData.description:
Input for topic ideation. `topic` is an optional steer — when blank the
agent leans entirely on the company profile + Tavily trend research; when
given, ideas are angled around that topic instead of a free niche scan.
SuggestPostTopicsData.title: SuggestPostTopicsData

SuggestSocialMediaTopicsData.description:
Input for Step 1 (10 viral topics). `niche` is an optional steer — when
blank the agent leans entirely on the company profile + Tavily trend
research, mirroring {@see \Modules\Post\Application\DTOs\SuggestPostTopicsData}.
SuggestSocialMediaTopicsData.title: SuggestSocialMediaTopicsData
